Quick load times, small amount of storage taken up, and it runs well - I imagine even on very old hardware. It also runs flawlessly on Linux. The issue is, I just don't think the game is good. The wall climbing and everything is cool I guess? But it just leads to people flying all over the map, and it's kind of obnoxious. We used to have an entire fleet of F2P shooters in the 2000s and early 2010s that were actually solid games. I don't think this is one of their successors.

I will say I am extremely impressed for a wannabe COD game.

You could say this game is COD but cranked up 250%. The movement is nuts (in a very good way) and the PVP is simple and clean. It runs on potatoes, is ridiculously small for a shooter (4gb), and the grind is very easy

You can get nice skins and goodies very easily without spending a dime. Easy, not burning out grinding does the trick. Doing daily tasks will definitely help you towards what you want to get. The lootbox mechanic is sometimes iffy, but I can't complain when the game is free, getting currency is free, and the contents of the loot boxes are actually good.

I cannot recommend this enough to anyone who either can't afford a COD like game, or if your PC is a literal potato (yes it will run). It is very easy to get into, and I would say the dopamine rush is as good if not better than COD (if that's what you are aiming for).

cohorts.summary: Reviewers highlight smooth performance on low-end systems alongside complaints about confusing menus, aggressive microtransactions, bots in lobbies, and cheaters.

claims.claim: The game runs well on low-end hardware, laptops, and integrated graphics.

citations.review_text: Honestly this is like playing CoD when it was fun to play with friends. There is a lot still to come with some perks and streaks marked as COMING SOON. Classic maps we are all used to and it runs really well even on a lower spec pc. I got a solid 120fps on my set up and had a 4 hour session with the lads like it was 2009 all over again. Weapons are fun and level up the same as we all know. Levelling unlocks attachments and there are camo challenges too. Battle Pass is present but is super cheap compared to the main franchise we all know of. Hours of fun even with bots just to level the weapons. This could go huge and take us all back to the days we enjoyed the most.
